title: FROG: Efficient Range-Filtering Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search on GPUs
abstract: arXiv:2608.16491v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Range-filtering approximate nearest neighbor search (RFANNS) is a fundamental operation in modern vector databases. Given a query vector $q$ and a numerical range predicate, RFANNS returns the $k$-approximate nearest neighbors ($k$-ANN) of the query $q$ among the objects whose attributes satisfy the range predicate. However, existing RFANNS methods are not well suited to high-throughput GPU execution. CPU indexes offer limited parallel scalability, generic GPU filtering is highly selectivity-dependent, and GPU indexes built from locally optimized subgraphs can incur long search trajectories and redundant distance computations. To address these limitations, we present FROG, a GPU-oriented RFANNS index that replaces multiple locally optimal substructure building with a globally aware, vertex-centric design. It organizes diverse expansion neighbor candidates for each vertex in a GPU-friendly structure and rapidly identifies the expansion

translated_title: FROG：GPU上的高效范围过滤近似最近邻搜索
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16491v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：范围过滤近似最近邻搜索（RFANNS）是现代向量数据库中的基本操作。给定一个查询向量$q$和一个数值范围谓词，RFANNS在属性满足范围谓词的对象中返回查询$q$的$k$个近似最近邻（$k$-ANN）。然而，现有的RFANNS方法不适合高吞吐量的GPU执行。CPU索引提供有限的并行可扩展性，通用GPU过滤高度依赖选择性，而基于局部优化子图构建的GPU索引可能导致长搜索轨迹和冗余距离计算。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了FROG，一种面向GPU的RFANNS索引，它用全局感知的顶点中心设计取代了多个局部最优子结构构建。它以一种对GPU友好的结构为每个顶点组织多样化的扩展邻居候选，并快速识别扩展。
tldr: FROG提出了一种面向GPU的全局感知顶点中心索引设计，通过优化邻居候选组织来显著提升范围过滤近似最近邻搜索的效率。
en_tdlr: FROG proposes a GPU-oriented, globally aware vertex-centric index design that enhances range-filtering approximate nearest neighbor search efficiency by optimizing neighbor candidate organization.
